entities.summary: Mariana Brito da Cruz Forjaz Secca, known professionally as Maro, is a Portuguese singer and songwriter. She won Festival da Canção 2022 and represented Portugal in the Eurovision Song Contest 2022 in Turin, Italy with the song "Saudade, saudade".
